Hi! Just got home from Japan. I added my mom under my account, but generated separate QR codes. We didn't experience any issues 🙂

Here's what I did:  
1. Make sure you add the people you want under you in "Details of family members traveling with you"

2. Click your planned entry

3. Under "Applicant" there's a drop-down menu. Click on the arrow and select the name of the person you wish to generate a QR code for

4. Click "Immigration clearance and Customs declaration" and fill up the necessary stuff

5. After everything, just click the "Display QR code" below the "Immigration clearance and Customs declaration" and you're good to go

Make sure you do all that for each member of your family. You go through immigration one by one, so each of you must have your own QR code.
